options.text: Leaf X shows parallel venation because it has many veins.
Leaf Y shows reticulate venation because both leaves are green.

stem:
Preeti holds two leaves. Leaf X has a thick middle vein with a net-like pattern of veins on both sides. Leaf Y has veins that run side by side along the leaf.

Which claims correctly label the venation? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: A net-like vein pattern is reticulate venation; veins running side by side are parallel venation. Having many veins or being green does not swap the labels.
